data_classification_scheme_established.title: Data Classification Scheme Established
data_classification_scheme_established.description: A documented data-classification scheme (CIS 3.7) is maintained and referenced by DLP policies, so sensitive content can be matched against defined categories. Secure value: true.

sensitive_data_inventory_and_discovery.title: Sensitive Data Inventory & Discovery
sensitive_data_inventory_and_discovery.description: State of the sensitive-data inventory and data-at-rest discovery (CIS 3.1/3.2). Secure value: maintained_with_discovery_scans (inventory kept current AND periodic discovery scans run).

network_egress_dlp_enabled.title: Network Egress DLP Enabled
network_egress_dlp_enabled.description: DLP is deployed and actively inspecting outbound traffic at managed interfaces / the network perimeter (SC-7(10); CIS 3.13). Secure value: true.

dlp_enforcement_mode.title: DLP Enforcement Mode
dlp_enforcement_mode.description: Enforcement mode of high-severity DLP policies. Secure value: block (actively stops exfiltration, versus monitor-only or off which only log or do nothing).

tls_inspection_enabled.title: TLS/SSL Inspection Enabled
tls_inspection_enabled.description: TLS/SSL inspection is enabled on the DLP egress path so encrypted channels are not a content-inspection blind spot (SC-7(10)). Secure value: true.

deep_packet_inspection_enabled.title: Deep Packet Inspection Enabled
deep_packet_inspection_enabled.description: Deep packet inspection / protocol-format adherence is enforced on the DLP egress path so content can be examined beyond headers (SC-7(10)). Secure value: true.

endpoint_dlp_agent_coverage.title: Endpoint DLP Agent Coverage
endpoint_dlp_agent_coverage.description: Endpoint DLP agents are deployed on all managed endpoints and reconciled to the asset inventory (M1057; CIS 3.13). Secure value: true.

removable_media_control_enabled.title: Removable Media Control Enabled
removable_media_control_enabled.description: Device control blocks or encrypts sensitive writes to USB / removable media (CIS 3.9; M1057 counters T1052/.001). Secure value: true.

email_dlp_gateway_enabled.title: Email DLP Gateway Enabled
email_dlp_gateway_enabled.description: Outbound email is routed through a DLP-inspecting mail gateway operating in enforce mode. Secure value: true.

web_cloud_casb_dlp_enabled.title: Web & Cloud (CASB) DLP Enabled
web_cloud_casb_dlp_enabled.description: Web uploads and cloud-app traffic are inspected via SWG/CASB enforce-mode DLP (mitigates T1567 exfiltration over web services and T1537 cloud transfer). Secure value: true.

information_flow_rules_bound_to_classifi.title: Information-Flow Rules Bound to Classification
information_flow_rules_bound_to_classifi.description: DLP enforces information-flow restrictions that are bound to data classification labels/categories (AC-4). Secure value: true.

dlp_exceptions_governed_and_recertified.title: DLP Exceptions Governed & Recertified
dlp_exceptions_governed_and_recertified.description: DLP exceptions / allow-lists are documented, approved, time-bound, and periodically recertified so they do not become permanent exfiltration gaps (AC-4 / SC-7(10)). Secure value: true.

dlp_policy_hit_alerting_enabled.title: DLP Policy-Hit Alerting Enabled
dlp_policy_hit_alerting_enabled.description: DLP policy hits raise alerts into a monitored SOC/SIEM workflow rather than only being logged (SI-4; SC-7(10)). Secure value: true.

exfiltration_testing_performed.title: Exfiltration Testing Performed
exfiltration_testing_performed.description: Exfiltration-capability tests are run on a defined frequency to validate that DLP detects and blocks representative data-egress attempts (SC-7(10)). Secure value: true.
